##### Project general facts

Jasmine Hills is a premium townhouse development by Reportage Properties, one of the largest private real estate developers in the UAE with a growing presence across Africa. The project comprises 59 upscale townhouses in Kacyiru, one of Kigali's most central and well-connected districts, conceived around Italian-inspired contemporary architecture that blends elegance with a strong sense of community. All residences are four-bedroom townhouses across three distinct types, spanning two to three levels with private gardens, rooftop terraces in select units, basements, and covered parking. The development is built to international standards and expected to be completed within the next few years from its October 2025 launch.

The community is designed around an active lifestyle and family-centred living. On-site, residents have access to a sports club, swimming pools, kids' play areas, green areas, community retail and shopping. The surrounding neighbourhood further extends this infrastructure with parks, a sports centre, schools, modern retail options, cafés, and restaurants — creating a seamlessly connected environment both inside and outside the gates.

Each townhouse at Jasmine Hills is delivered with a full premium finish. Buyers have the freedom to select their preferred finishing materials and interior fittings, allowing for a degree of personalisation uncommon in the market. Standard inclusions across all units cover kitchen cabinets and countertops, fully tiled bathrooms including en-suites and guest toilets, showers in each bathroom, central air conditioning, private balconies and terraces as per unit plan, storage units, mirrors, and — in select townhouses — a maid's room and large rooftop garden.

##### Parking
Shared parking.

##### Location description and benefits

Jasmine Hills is located in Kacyiru, Gasabo District — one of Kigali's most prestigious and strategically positioned neighbourhoods, home to government ministries, foreign embassies, and some of the city's most sought-after residential addresses. The area sits at the heart of the capital, offering effortless connectivity to Kigali's key business, diplomatic, and lifestyle destinations.

The US Embassy is just a few minutes away, King Faisal Hospital and Kigali Golf Resort are reachable in under ten minutes, and Kigali Convention City, the University of Rwanda, and Kigali's downtown core are all within a short drive. BK Arena and Amahoro National Stadium are roughly fifteen to twenty minutes away, and Kigali International Airport is approximately twenty-three minutes by car.

Kigali's real estate market is one of Africa's fastest-growing, underpinned by strong governance, political stability, and a rapidly expanding expat and professional community driving consistent rental demand. The city consistently ranks among Africa's most business-friendly destinations, and Kacyiru's central position within it makes Jasmine Hills a compelling proposition for both owner-occupiers seeking a premium address and investors looking for long-term value appreciation in an emerging market with strong fundamentals.
